gloss: row; arrangement; the same side of the street

definitions.explanation: The way things are lined up or arranged.

definitions.gloss: the same row; the same side of the street
definitions.explanation: The same line of buildings, especially on the same side of a street as somewhere else.

examples.japanese: {並|なら}び⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変|か}える→変える：01089_kaeru⟧。

examples.english: The books on the shelf are neatly lined up.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{表|ひょう}→表：19354_hyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{並|なら}び⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{五十音順|ごじゅうおんじゅん}になっている。
examples.english: In this table the names are arranged in kana order.

examples.japanese: ⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧{並|なら}び⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧。
examples.english: A shop on the same side of the street.

examples.japanese: ⟦{郵便局|ゆうびんきょく}→郵便局：00579_yuubinkyoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{銀行|ぎんこう}→銀行：00578_ginkou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧{並|なら}び⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The post office is on the same side of the street as the bank.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{並|なら}び⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦パン{屋|や}→パン屋：19415_panya⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できて→できる：00557_dekiru⟧、⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦{匂|にお}い→匂い：00874_nioi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A new bakery has opened on our side of the street, and it smells good every morning.

notes:
The noun from ⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧ (to line up).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{歯並|はなら}び→歯並び：32305_hanarabi⟧: the alignment of one's teeth
- ⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧{並|なら}び: the same side of the street
- {並|なら}び⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ / ⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧: well / badly arranged

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{列|れつ}→列：02171_retsu⟧: a line or queue of people or things; {並|なら}び is about how things are arranged
- ⟦{順番|じゅんばん}→順番：03283_junban⟧: order, turn
- {並|なら}びに: and (a formal conjunction), a separate word
